items.q: I had a close friend in the band, sitting right next to me. His name was William Granger

ctx.x: About 1928, and the guy come through there and he says -- he was around the Musicians' Club there, and he was asking -- they need a trumpet player and a clarinet. They

only had one trumpet. And so they said, "Well, there's a kid around here who plays pretty good trumpet. Maybe he'll go, he'll take it." "His name is Jonah Jones. He'll be coming by here after awhile. Maybe --," so I went by, and the guy asked me about it, and I had a close friend in the band, sitting right next to me. His name was William Granger, and he played beautiful horn, beautiful trumpet, you know. I liked his playing. And we were buddies. And so the guy asked me would I go.
